versionBumps.patch: Corrections that preserve required fields and behavior
versionBumps.major: Incompatible schema changes with explicit migration

activation: Immutable versioned artifacts first; atomically replace the sole current index last; checkpoint the complete packet in one Git commit.
fingerprint: SHA-256 of sorted source path, file kind/executable mode, byte length and content. Exclude only generated recovery directory and current index to avoid self-reference. Index artifact hashes and exact generated text are validated separately.
liveHeads: Recorded main/candidate/recovery heads are observations before generation, not future commit predictions. Resolve live refs and compare source fingerprints and transaction expectations before mutation.
